question: How do yoga, worthiness, splendor, and universal embodiment define the divine figure?
premises: The figure is yoga and worthy.
The figure is of great splendor.
The figure is the form of all siddhas and others.
inference: The divine figure embodies yoga, worthiness, radiant power, and the forms of perfected beings.
plain_english: He is yoga, worthy, of great splendor, and the form of all siddhas and others.
